text:
DeployBot: [AUTO-RUN] Canary p95 latency breach detected for rollout v3.7.0 -> suggested action: partial rollback to v3.6.4 on canary slice. Reason: KV-cache miss amplification + kernel mismatch. (alert #RWD-1234)
Leah Ops: seeing logs? can someone confirm scope of affected hosts?
Joan SRE: quick confirm — 3 of 8 canary workers in eu-west-1 show repeated 504 + OOM spikes. sampling logs: `oom: alloc failed at tokenize()`
Ravi Eng: ack. repro looks correlated to quantized kernel switch. dev runtime flagged a fallback path but didn't engage due to compat flag missing.
Leah Ops: DeployBot offered auto-rollback. do we want fully automated revert or manual exec? change window ends in 45m.
Cassie PM: customer impact? any in-flight dedicated customers?
Joan SRE: low error volume, but p95 latency doubled for public API calls in slice. Not yet a broad outage.
Ravi Eng: propose manual guided-rewind: run partial rollback on canary slice only, pin canary to v3.6.4, keep rollout paused. That buys time for a hotpatch.
Leah Ops: agree. execute partial rollback now. Ravi, can you own the pin and hotpatch? I will run the rollback commands and notify support.
Ravi Eng: taking ownership of pin + hotpatch. will open a PR and create a canary hotfix branch.
Leah Ops: Oncall Bot, please create incident in PagerDuty and add RWD-1234.
Oncall Bot: Incident created: RWD-1234 (Canary latency spike). Assigned: Joan SRE, Leah Ops.
Leah Ops: rollback command (canary slice):
```
/rollout revert --target=canary --to-version=3.6.4 --reason="kv-kernel-compat-oom" --ticket=RWD-1234
```
Leah Ops: running now.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated on canary slice. Progress: 2/8 nodes reverted. ETA 3m.
Joan SRE: monitoring metrics: p95 dropping back toward baseline, error-rate trending down.
Cassie PM: drafting a short customer note for the status page: "We detected increased latency during a canary rollout and safely reverted the canary while we prepare a fix. No dedicated customers impacted." share for review?
Ravi Eng: please add a technical blurb: cause = quantized kernel path + missing compat flag; mitigation = revert to 3.6.4 + patch to gating logic.
Leah Ops: once rollback completes, I'll pin the canary model in the routing table and freeze the rollout. command to pin: `/model pin --env=canary --model-version=3.6.4 --reason=post-rollback`
DeployBot: Rollback complete. 8/8 canary nodes running v3.6.4. Canary metrics stable. Auto-rollback suppressed for this change until manual review.
Joan SRE: opening an internal postmortem ticket: PM-ROLLBACK-1809998765. Include timeline and logs.
Cassie PM: I posted the customer-facing blurb on status.redwood.ai/incidents/1809998765-draft. Sending to legal for review.
Ravi Eng: starting hotpatch branch, will run integration tests against canary pinned. ETA 2 hours.
Leah Ops: follow-ups: (1) add canary logs to RWD-1234, (2) update release notes to mark v3.7.0 as paused with rollback note, (3) prepare rollback comms for Dedicated customers if needed.
Joan SRE: thumbs up. I will keep monitoring for 30m then hand back to Ravi for fix verification.
Leah Ops: thanks everyone — manual guided-rewind executed cleanly. We avoided a full revert and kept the change window stable. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Note: auto-rollback thresholds reset. Manual intervention logged under RWD-1234.
